# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 8 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus (ch 1-31) / P.Mich. 130 (ch 32+), Shepherd of Hermas 8 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_008_page_001.jpg

---

## Vision 2, Chapter 4

**1** After finishing, she asked me, "Any more questions?" "Yes, one," I said. "Why is the tower being built on water?" "Because," she told me, "your life has been saved and will be saved through water. But the tower itself rests on the word of the almighty and glorious Name, and it is upheld by the Lord's unseen power." **2** "That is extraordinary," I said. "But who are the six young men doing the building?" "They are the holy angels of God — the first-created ones — to whom the Lord gave authority over all creation, to build it up, expand it, and govern it. Through them the Lord will bring the tower to completion." **3** "And the thousands of other workers?" "Also holy angels, but the six are their superiors. When the building is done, everyone will gather around the tower and celebrate together, praising God because it is complete." **4** "What happens to the stones that are rejected?" She answered: "Those not thrown far away — the ones that just sit near the tower — are people who have sinned and want to repent. They're still within reach of the building. If they turn around now, they can still be fitted in. But once the tower is done, they'll be shut out permanently." **5** "The cracked ones are hypocrites — people who believe one thing and do another. They run hot and cold. Their deeds are wicked." **6** "Those thrown far away are the thoroughly wicked — people who accepted the faith but never let go of their evil. God's anger has put them out of reach of the building permanently." **7** "The rough unused ones — those are people who once knew the truth but walked away from it and cut themselves off from the community of believers. They've made themselves useless." **8** "The ones that look cracked but appear whole on the outside — those are people who nurse grudges. They act friendly enough face-to-face, but the moment they part from each other the resentment comes flooding back. The cracks are internal." **9** "The ones thrown in the fire — those have completely and permanently turned away from the living God. Repentance never comes to mind for them, because their lifestyle of lust and wickedness has taken total hold." **10** "The ones that nearly rolled into the water but couldn't quite get there — those are people who heard the message and genuinely wanted to be baptized. But when the full weight of holy living came home to them, they lost their nerve and went back to their old desires." **11** "That's enough about the tower," she said. "These explanations are sufficient — but make sure you take them all to heart." Then she turned to the virgins: "Keep building diligently — don't let the master get tired of waiting and find another way." Then she left, along with the builders and all the virgins who had been standing around the tower. And when I looked, the tower had disappeared. All I could see were the stones, still lying on the ground.

---

*PNEUMA note: The virgins are a new element — they will be identified with the virtues/spirits in Vision 3. Their presence around the tower connects tower-building to moral virtue.*
